visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a four-way split screen. Top-left shows hands in black gloves assembling a rice wrap on a mat. Top-right features a man in a blue shirt with short dark hair eating the wrap. Bottom-left shows the same man holding a wrapped food item. Bottom-right displays pieces of chicken frying in a large, deep metal wok filled with bubbling oil. (2) The scene shifts to close-ups of menu boards with bright yellow and red colors, displaying food prices and images in Thai and English. Then, the camera shows a street view at night, focusing on a large sign for 'HeaRoy' featuring a graphic of a woman riding a giant rooster. (3) In an indoor kitchen setting with yellow tiled walls, a staff member wearing a white hairnet and gloves uses a large metal strainer to lift golden-brown fried chicken from a wok. Steam rises from the hot oil. (4) The main male character in a blue shirt is seen sitting indoors, taking a large bite of a wrap, his eyes wide with an expressive, surprised look. He gestures with his hands to emphasize the food's quality. Later, he is shown outdoors at a green table, followed by a woman with long brown hair taking a bite of the same snack. (5) Final montage showing the internal ingredients of the wrap, featuring fried crumbs and chicken. The man continues eating enthusiastically while the camera pans to the front of the 'Haroy Hatyai Fried Chicken' restaurant with yellow and red signage.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male host with short black hair wearing a light blue button-down shirt and a black watch. A female guest with long brown hair wearing a grey graphic t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between a busy street food area at night with neon signs, a brightly lit indoor restaurant with yellow tiles and wooden accents, and a professional kitchen setup with large woks and stainless steel counters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, upbeat electronic dance music begins immediately. A male voice speaks with high energy and rapid delivery in Mandarin, introducing the food scene in Bangkok. The pitch is medium-high, conveying excitement. (2) A loud sizzle sound (broadband noise) of chicken hitting hot oil is heard as the visuals show the cooking process. The music continues in the background, but the sizzling is prominent. (3) A distinct 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs as the scene cuts to the menu. The male narrator maintains a fast pace, describing the various options available. (4) A sharp, percussive crunching sound is audible when the host takes a bite of the wrap. The vocal tone becomes more relaxed but remains positive as he describes the texture. (5) A female voice enters with high arousal and a cheerful tone, agreeing with the host's assessment. The background music maintains its steady, rhythmic pulse until the very end, where it ends on a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Environmental Context -> Product Preparation -> User Experience -> Final Verdict
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote and review a specific street food item, a 'Fried Chicken Wrap,' in the Chulalongkorn area of Bangkok. By showcasing the vibrant cooking process, the low price point (89 Baht), and the enthusiastic reactions of both a male and female taster, the creator seeks to recommend this culinary discovery to a travel-oriented audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed display of the restaurant logo, address information, social media links, and a very positive recommendation of the food.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-density 'social-native' editing style common on platforms like TikTok or Reels, characterized by rapid cuts, constant text overlays, and high-energy narration to maintain viewer engagement.
